extensions.platform: terminal (OpenTUI + Bun); colours are live ANSI palette roles, example hexes are theme.ts FALLBACK

ink-fg.canonical: OSC 10 default foreground, else ANSI 15; floor 7:1 on night

core.canonical: dark: mix(night, black, 0.6); light: mix(fg, night, 0.12)

display.purpose: The selected tool's name only; baked URW Gothic Demi half-block bitmaps.

title.purpose: Product mark, full tool name, reader titles, pill label; bold.

body.purpose: Action labels, paths, reader content; terminal font, regular fg.

label.purpose: Versions, hints, facts, hint-bar words; dim.

glyphs.braille: U+2800 block: hairlines, orbits, halo, rings, stars, spinner
glyphs.halfBlock: ▀ with fg/bg: fills, core, bodies, glow, display type

shadows.name: corona
shadows.value: radial half-block glow from 0.95 to 1.9 core radii in selected ink, strength 0.34 to 0.44 (+0.55 flare)
shadows.purpose: Light around the core; one of exactly two glows.

shadows.name: selected-body-glow
shadows.value: radial glow from 1.05 to 2.1 body radii, strength 0.2

shadows.name: recede
shadows.value: scene mixed up to 62% toward night; labels 60%
shadows.purpose: Scene sinks into shadow behind reader views.

motion.name: swing
motion.purpose: System turns by one shared delta so the selected body reaches the front.

motion.name: emerge
motion.value: 850 ms, expo-out; body grows from 35% scale; corona flare decays at 2.2/s
motion.purpose: After any VM hand-off the selected body rises from the core.

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: 550 ms, cubic in-out; bodies appear over 450 ms + 120 ms per index

motion.name: name-slide
motion.value: 320 ms, expo-out; new name enters from 5 cells right, old leaves 4 cells left
motion.purpose: Display name change on tool select.

motion.name: reader-recede
motion.value: exponential approach, rate 14/s; reader enters from 6 cells right, list leaves 4 cells left
motion.purpose: Reader views slide in on one axis while the scene dims up to 62%.

motion.name: pill-glide
motion.purpose: Focused pill follows the cursor between rows.

motion.name: pill-flash
motion.purpose: Enter feedback, held two frames before the hand-off.

motion.name: last-session-fade
motion.value: held 0.3 s, then 0.6 s expo-out fade-in
motion.purpose: Session summary arrives with the emerging body.

motion.name: audit-sweep
motion.purpose: Audit in progress, drawn on top of the halo ring.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Idle drift of unselected bodies; one lap in 5 to 10 minutes.

motion.name: frame-budget
motion.value: 60 fps while animating, 20 fps idle, 12 fps with UMBRA_REDUCED_MOTION=1 (all transitions instant)

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.value: width < 64 cols, or height < 20 rows, or stack orrery < 9 rows

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.value: default between tiny and wide; orrery up to 44% height, max 30 rows

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.value: width >= 118 cols and width/height >= 1.85; orrery 52% width

breakpoints.name: chrome-inset
breakpoints.value: height >= 32 rows: header and status line inset one row

narrative.overview:
The terminal's own background is the night. On it, a black core sits inside a corona coloured by the selected tool, ringed by a dotted halo that is the egress mode, and three tilted braille orbits carry one body per tool. Choosing a tool turns the whole system so its body swings to the front; launching sends it into the shadow, and when the session ends it re-emerges from behind the core. Every mark on screen is real state. Positions along the orbits are the one exception: they only keep the system alive.

The system owns no colours. Every role is an ANSI palette slot read live through OSC 4/10/11 queries and re-read on the terminal's `palette` event, so the scene follows the user's wallpaper. The hex values in the frontmatter are the FALLBACK palette in `theme.ts`, used only when the terminal stays silent; treat them as examples of a resolved theme, never as the identity. A contrast floor (`ensureContrast` in `color.ts`) pulls any slot toward the foreground until it clears its role's ratio against the background.

Density is low and type-led: one large word, a short facts block, seven or eight keyed actions, a status line. Regions have no boxes. A region is marked only by four corner registration ticks.
keyCharacteristics: Palette roles, not colours: every ink is an ANSI index with a contrast floor.
One large thing on screen: the selected tool's name in baked display type.
Hairline braille orbits at one weight; solid shapes in anti-aliased half-blocks.
Damped, single-axis motion that never delays a launch.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Never write a literal colour. Every ink is an ANSI slot or a mix of night, fg and black, resolved at runtime and re-resolved when the palette changes.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Inks clear 3:1, dim clears 4.5:1, fg clears 7:1 against night; `ensureContrast` moves the slot toward fg in 5% steps until it does.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Halo violet means egress; yellow means real risk. Neither appears as decoration.

rules.name: The One Large Word Rule
rules.body: Only the selected tool's name is display-sized. Everything else is one cell tall.

rules.name: The Inherited Face Rule
rules.body: Body text uses whatever font the terminal uses; the system never asks for a face it cannot see.

rules.name: The Two Glows Rule
rules.body: Only the corona and the selected body glow. Unselected bodies, rings and text never do.

rules.name: The Front Window Rule
rules.body: The front of the orbits belongs to the selected body. Other bodies are pushed out of a 1-radian window on selection and never drift into a 0.9-radian window at rest.

rules.name: The No Box Rule
rules.body: No borders, frames or panels. A region is announced by four corner ticks or by nothing.

dos: **Do** take every ink from an ANSI slot through `buildTheme`, and re-read it on the palette event.
**Do** mark regions with corner registration ticks in hair.
**Do** keep motion on one axis and damped: exponential ease-out for swings and slides, cubic in-out only for the orbits drawing on (550 ms).
**Do** honour `UMBRA_REDUCED_MOTION=1`: every transition becomes instant and the loop drops to 12 fps.
**Do** tie every mark to real state; if a mark has no state behind it, it goes.
donts: **Don't** draw boxes, borders or framed panels around any region.
**Don't** set a second word in display type, or use display type outside the three baked tool names.
**Don't** use halo violet or warn yellow for anything but egress and real risk.
**Don't** let any animation delay Enter: launch is the main act.
**Don't** go hacker cliché: no neon green, glitch, matrix rain or "cyber" styling.
